nodes.summary: The set of admissible radii is bounded below.
nodes.title: The admissible radii are bounded below

nodes.summary: A real number $R$ is an admissible radius if $R > 0$ and, for every integer $n \ge 2$ and every complex polynomial $f$ of degree $n$ whose zeros all lie in the closed unit disk $|z| \le 1$, every zero $\lambda$ of $f$ has a critical point within distance $R$, that is, a zero $c$ of the derivative $f'$ with $|c - \lambda| \le R$.
nodes.title: Admissible radius in Sendov's problem

nodes.summary: This is the proposition that the Sendov radius is at least $1$.
nodes.title: Lower bound one for the Sendov radius

nodes.summary: If $R$ is an admissible radius and $R \le S$, then $S$ is an admissible radius.
nodes.title: Enlarging an admissible radius

nodes.summary: Sendov's conjecture is true: the Sendov radius is at most $1$.
nodes.title: Sendov's conjecture holds

nodes.summary: Sendov's conjecture is the proposition that the Sendov radius is at most $1$.
nodes.title: Sendov's conjecture

nodes.summary: If $R$ is an admissible radius, then the Sendov radius is at most $R$.
nodes.title: Admissible radii bound the Sendov radius

nodes.summary: The Sendov radius is the infimum, as a real number, of the set of admissible radii in Sendov's problem.
nodes.title: The Sendov radius

nodes.summary: This is the proposition that the Sendov radius is at most $2$.
nodes.title: Upper bound two for the Sendov radius

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
